Kimberly,

Thanks again for the support over the last three weeks — the team has made good progress running Redwood in our staging environment. We hit a couple of data gating issues that pushed our model validation back by a week, and we'd like to request a short extension of the pilot so engineering can finish a final validation sweep.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood add a 3-week extension to the current timebox (same environment + model) at no additional charge?
- If we convert to a paid dedicated deployment within 30 days of the pilot end, is there flexibility on a first-month credit or a short-term discount to help our finance signoff?

I've attached a usage snapshot (ClearTrace_POC_usage_report.csv) so you can see token/throughput patterns. 

If helpful, Tom (cc'd) can loop procurement — procurement@cleartrace.ai — but wanted to start here.

Appreciate a quick read — hope we can land something modest to keep momentum.

Sarah — thanks for the note and the usage snapshot. Happy to help keep momentum. Two paths that I can offer quickly (pick whichever aligns better with procurement):

Option A — Timebox extension + transitional credit
- 3-week extension to the existing pilot (same infra and support) at no incremental infra cost.
- One-time credit equal to 25% of pilot usage this month, applied to the first invoice after conversion.

Option B — Fixed credit up-front (simpler for procurement)
- We provide a $15,000 credit that applies to the first month of a converted dedicated contract.
- Pilot extension limited to 1 additional week unless a conversion signature is in flight.

We can also combine a modest extension with a smaller credit if you'd prefer (e.g., 2 weeks + $10k). For legal/ops, I'll prepare a short SOW addendum (attached: ClearTrace_SOW_draft.pdf) that captures the extension and credit mechanics.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Tell me which option procurement prefers (A/B/combination).
2) If procurement wants to see finance language, I'll loop in our finance lead for an approval note.
3) Once you pick, I'll send the SOW addendum and a DocuSign link for signatures.
